payload.claim: The acceptance criterion requires the proxy's build command to cite `images/proxy.Dockerfile` and the base's to cite `images/cell-base.python.Dockerfile`, but no test in this diff ever checks the `-f <dockerfile>` portion of a build line. `tests/test_preflight.py` and `tests/test_cli.py` contain no occurrence of either Dockerfile path, only `build -t <tag>` substring and count checks. Swapping the two file strings in `_IMAGE_SOURCES` (proxy mapped to the base Dockerfile and vice versa) would send the operator to build the wrong image from the wrong Dockerfile for each tag, yet every existing assertion (`detail.count("build -t")`, `f"podman build -t {base_tag} " in detail`, `detail.count(str(root))`) still passes unchanged. The `criteria` gate reports pass, so the PR body claims this criterion satisfied, but the test suite cannot currently distinguish a correct dockerfile mapping from a swapped one.
